Management Plan

- Probable viral upper respiratory tract infection/early influenza; conservative management:
  • Rest, maintain hydration.  
  • Paracetamol for fever and discomfort.  
  • Delayed prescription: Amoxicillin 1 tablet three times daily; commence if symptoms not improving after 24–48 h.
- Safety-net advice: Return sooner if worsening shortness of breath, high fever, chest pain, or if not improved by next week.
- Chronic disease considerations:
  • Reinforced importance of smoking cessation; encouraged continued use of vaping device as step-down.  
  • Brief alcohol counseling; advised to keep intake within recommended limits.
- Follow-up: Review in one week if no improvement or sooner if deterioration.
